quantization.status: NO-GO for early exact down A8 generation under the existing numerical reference
quantization.contract: The full original activation vector uses one dynamic maxabs/127 A8 scale before any full-C dot.
quantization.consequence: Same ready chunk can require different A8 bytes after the unseen tail arrives. Block quantization/static scale is a numerical-format change. Native output summation support alone does not remove this input-scale dependency.
quantization.qualification: This is a reference-format barrier, not a claim that all possible AiF input formats have a global quantizer. It also does not establish numerical equivalence to the original NVFP4 routing checkpoint.
